<action type="say">
Here’s how to move your “Teacher Meeting” in Google Calendar to Saturday, Dec 13, same time (10–11 am Eastern).

On a computer (calendar.google.com):
1) Open Google Calendar and go to December 2025.  
2) Click the “Teacher Meeting” on Friday, Dec 12 at 10:00 am.  
3) In the pop‑up, click the pencil (Edit) icon.  
4) In the “Date” field, change the date from Dec 12 to Sat, Dec 13, 2025.  
5) Make sure the time still shows 10:00–11:00 am and the time zone is Eastern.  
6) Click “Save.”

Even faster on computer (drag-and-drop):
1) In Month or Week view, find “Teacher Meeting” on Fri, Dec 12 at 10:00 am.  
2) Click and hold the event, drag it to Sat, Dec 13 at 10:00 am, then release.  
3) If a confirmation appears, click “Save” or “OK.”

On the Google Calendar mobile app (Android or iOS):
1) Open the Google Calendar app and go to December 2025.  
2) Tap the “Teacher Meeting” on Fri, Dec 12 at 10:00 am.  
3) Tap the pencil (Edit) icon.  
4) Tap the date and change it to Sat, Dec 13, 2025.  
5) Confirm the time is still 10:00–11:00 am and the time zone is Eastern.  
6) Tap “Save” (top right).

If you tell me whether you’re on web or phone (and Android vs iPhone), I can tailor these even more tightly to what you’ll see on screen.</action>
